integrity: The universal endomorphism parameterization is established in earlier literature and not claimed new; originality is restricted to the idempotence fiber analysis, conjugacy census, and finite-field rank polynomial. No independent audit or publication claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Not a classification of higher-step free algebras, nonfree nilpotent quotients, or all endomorphisms. Exhaustive checks are finite and do not establish the unrestricted algebraic result. The literature comparison leaves residual risks of equivalent retraction counts under alternate terminology.
scientific_scope: Every field, generator dimension n at least 2; free two-step nilpotent Lie algebra and all Lie-algebra endomorphism retractions. Finite-field point counts hold for every prime power.
title: Retraction orbits and finite-field rank spectra of free two-step nilpotent Lie algebras
